why: Deploy builds run where CI does not: a missing peer or a stale ejected seed must fail the build naming the command, and ejected files must resolve and reload.
what: packages/basalt-ui/src/vite/**, test/fixtures/vite/**. Donors in the 2.x tree: src/vite.ts, vite-boot.ts, vite-color-mix.ts and their tests; they stay in place (2.x entry) and the new src/vite/** is the v3 entry the ./vite export points at. The build-time closure table is generated from the SLOTS and subpath allotment in ARCHITECTURE section 3.
must_not_touch: CHANGELOG.md, MIGRATING.md, llms.txt, scripts/check-budgets/**, other areas' migrations files
contract: Frozen: ARCHITECTURE.md, this domain's contract.ts, src/core/ports.ts. Need a change: factory signal, take the reversible default. Read ARCHITECTURE 4.3 (basalt() paragraph), section 11 F9, primitives-distribution section 6 last paragraph.
exemplar: 2.x packages/basalt-ui/src/vite.ts and vite.test.ts for plugin shape and config-hook tests.
change: basalt() at buildStart fails naming the exact bun add command on a missing peer of any imported subpath, and naming basalt-ui sync when an ejected file's recorded seedDigest differs from the installed seed. With ejects it sets the alias from the manifest, ssr.noExternal and optimizeDeps.exclude for composite subpaths; with none it sets none of these. Regenerates .basalt/sources.css each run: positive @source per imported subpath from a scan plus a build-time closure table, @source not per unused ui module and per ejected module's npm copy. Absorbs basaltAppPlugin (themeScript through transformIndexHtml, theme-color, manifest, PWA); delete the anti-FOUC style. Rule: none (build gate, rung 6). Skill: docs/vite.md generated. Tests: fixture-driven config and buildStart tests.
commits: One PR, separate package and non-package commits (isolated-basalt-ui); conventional, empty scope, no attribution.
proof: bun test test/fixtures/vite: programmatic vite build of fixtures, no dev server.
acceptance: a fixture importing basalt-ui/ui/date-picker without react-day-picker fails the build with 'bun add react-day-picker' in the message
bumping the seed digest of an ejected fixture fails the build naming 'basalt-ui sync'; an unchanged digest builds
a no-ejects fixture's resolved config has no alias, no ssr.noExternal, no optimizeDeps.exclude entries from basalt()
an ejected fixture's config has the alias, ssr.noExternal and optimizeDeps.exclude, and its SSR build resolves (no ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND)
.basalt/sources.css is regenerated byte-identically on a second run and lists @source not for each unused ui module
index.html output carries the theme script once and no inline anti-FOUC style; F9 (HMR on an ejected file) is recorded as open for v3-spike-f3-eject, not claimed
git diff --name-only lists only owned paths
out_of_scope: Real dev-server HMR proof (F9), the ejects ceiling, non-Vite bundlers, CLI verbs.
worker_tag: lead high; the lead may spawn one @implementer tagged [opus: Build-time resolver and per-run source scan that must hold across SSR, eject and non-Vite profiles] for the novel file group only
